native.admission_inspect: Ivory card, blank. A hairline border almost closes, then does not.
apply_texts: A small clearness arrives, paper-thin, and does not feel like mercy.
Almost a name. The missed stroke leaves the calm a little cracked.
Last touch. The ivory cools. The corner remains unfinished.
The clearness returns, thinner. The blank has not grown kinder.
The same failure, one place over. Nothing is written.
Turned again. The omission recurs, elegant and unanswered.
You turn it once more. The gap has moved. No ink answers.
You turn the card. The border's gap meets your nail and slips.
Your thumb finds the open corner. A letter fails, politely.
inspect_texts: A faint pressure of type, stopped short. No word quite arrives.
Almost a letter, never a name. The border declines to finish it.
Blank again. Only the unfinished corner insists it was always so.
Fine stock. You nearly read a monogram, then only the open border.
Ivory card, blank. A hairline border almost closes, then does not.
Still blank. The gap has moved a finger's width, with no smudge.
The omission repeats cleanly. Elegance, and nothing you can name.
The pressure returns in the same place, one stroke less certain.
The stock is warmer than paper. You cannot find where you touched it.
You could swear the monogram changed. The card offers no ink.
native.name: Unclosed Card
